risk_summary: The excerpt provides useful quantified operating results and backlog data, but relies heavily on standard forward-looking disclaimers and broad, non-quantified risk categories. Key exposures include margin pressure from low-margin orders, construction-related delivery delays, commodity and labor cost inflation, customer collectability, actuarial assumptions, and limited demand visibility. The concluding outlook is cautiously optimistic, though this is tempered by substantial uncertainty around pricing power and project demand.
